E/M billed 8 days after cholecystectomy (a major surgical procedure) falls well within the 90-day global period per SOMB GR 3.2.1. Routine post-operative care — including this incision check, infection assessment, and surgical discharge — is included in the surgical fee and should not be billed separately to AHCIP. The reported mild fatigue is consistent with normal post-surgical recovery and does not constitute a genuinely unrelated condition warranting a separately billable visit. Suggested fix: do not bill this encounter to AHCIP. If the clinic determines the fatigue warrants a separately billable, unrelated E/M, attach explanatory text documenting the unrelated nature of the complaint. Do NOT apply a -24-style modifier (Alberta has no such modifier; GR 3.2.1 governs).
